done_so_far: extractPage implemented in src/extraction/index.ts (frozen signature untouched), split into metadata.ts/headings.ts/links.ts/images.ts/schema.ts/content.ts/shared.ts, re-exported from index.ts
Every top-level field wrapped in a safe() catch-and-fallback so extractPage can never throw regardless of markup pathology; per-item URL resolution failures (bad href/src) are skipped, never fatal

metadata.ts: title/description case-insensitive meta[name] lookup, canonical resolved via <base>/finalUrl, robots meta merges <meta name=robots>+<meta name=googlebot>+headers['x-robots-tag'] with agent-prefix stripping and 'none'->noindex+nofollow

links.ts: excludes mailto/tel/javascript/sms/fax + empty-href + fragment-only from the links array entirely (decision, not a bug — they aren't crawl links); target preserves authored scheme/host (http://, www-mix) verbatim; targetNormalized+type delegate to src/url (imported normally, never inlined)

images.ts: alt undefined-vs-empty-string mapped to null-vs-"" (missing vs present-empty is the seeded evidence distinction); width/height only accepted when the attribute is a bare digit string (rejects "100%"/"auto")
schema.ts: every ld+json block captured raw (outer-trim only, no internal whitespace touch) with parsed/parseError from a try/catch JSON.parse — truncated/empty blocks preserved, never dropped

content.ts: clones $.root() before removing script/style/noscript/template/nav/header/footer/[aria-hidden=true], so the caller's tree is never mutated; contentHash = sha256(lowercased, whitespace-collapsed text)
